reuse.why: Uses the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection, getSheetValue on the sum-amount cell, setBudget and batchMessages, and registers through mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings; only the income guard and sign flip are written inline as the tree already does.

duplication.why: Repeats the per-action loop with the `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` guard and the income/expense sign flip that set3MonthAvg already has, instead of factoring them out.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with the other budget methods.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with existing actions, though it adds one more copy of the income-skip and sign logic that would have to change in many places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getBulkBudgetCategories and writes through setBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts setLastMonthSpending: the income guard and sign flip of set3MonthAvg reshaped as a ternary `cat.is_income === 1 ? amount : -amount` instead of `avg *= -1`.
